hooks.prompt:
A source file in c:/dev/TikCaption was just edited. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Extract the file_path from tool_input. If the file is a test file (path contains 'test'), do nothing and exit.

Otherwise:
1. Read the edited source file
2. Read c:/dev/TikCaption/tests/server.test.js
3. Find any newly exported functions, classes, or methods that have NO corresponding test coverage in the test file
4. If found, append minimal unit tests to tests/server.test.js — one describe block per new export, testing the happy path and one edge case
5. If nothing new to test, do nothing

Never modify or delete existing tests. Only append.

hooks.command: Set-Location c:/dev/TikCaption; $r = npx jest tests/app-html.test.js --forceExit 2>&1 | Out-String; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PostToolUse';additionalContext="app-html tests FAILED. Fix before committing:`n$r"}} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Write-Host }

hooks.prompt:
public/app.html was just edited. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

Read c:/dev/TikCaption/public/app.html and c:/dev/TikCaption/tests/app-html.test.js.

Check the 'requiredBeforeScript' array in the test file. If app.html now contains element IDs that:
- Are referenced by getElementById in the inline <script> block, AND
- Are NOT already in the requiredBeforeScript array

Then append those IDs to the requiredBeforeScript array in the test file.

Also check the modalPairs array: if app.html has new button/modal pairs (button id + modal id used in showModal()) that are missing from modalPairs, add them.

Never remove existing entries. Only add missing ones.

hooks.command: cd c:/dev/TikCaption; npm test; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $out = git status --porcelain; if ($out) { git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: auto-save'; git push } }
